prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production 2D Sengoku battle-game sprite sheet, six genuine consecutive cloth-animation drawings of ONE freestanding Mori camp banner, no people.
Layout: exactly 3 equal columns by 2 equal rows, reading left to right then top to bottom. Prefer 1536x1024 canvas. Each cell has one COMPLETE isolated flag assembly from finial to entire tripod wooden base, with at least 25 pixels clear margin from every cell edge. Entire wooden pole is perfectly upright and stationary, identical size and grounded base position in all six cells. Pole plus base approx 430 pixels tall inside each 512x512 cell. No panel borders, no labels, no numbers.
Subject: a slim wooden pole with small metal fittings and a short top crossbar, stable humble wooden tripod/cross base. A deep dark teal vertical rectangular cloth banner hangs from the short top crossbar alongside the pole, natural worn fabric texture, not torn into strips. Cloth approximately 115px wide x 270px tall; leave substantial pole visible beneath it. Clearly readable WHITE Mori Ichimonji Mitsuboshi crest centered on cloth in EVERY frame: exactly ONE broad horizontal white bar above exactly THREE WHITE CIRCULAR DISCS in a compact triangular arrangement (one upper circle, two lower circles). The crest is solid white, no black outlines, no additional emblems, no lettering. Preserve same crest design through folds, never omit or add a disk.
Animation: six distinct evenly spaced moments in one gentle repeating cloth wind cycle, 0 small outward billow, 1 billow rising toward free right edge, 2 upper fold leading and lower hem trailing right, 3 billow relaxed through center, 4 lower fold returning and upper cloth softening, 5 returning smoothly toward frame0. Cloth contour and fold lines are actually redrawn each frame; do not simply rotate/tilt/sway the entire same image. Keep rod and base fixed absolutely. Natural small flag flutter suitable for 5fps looping, never violent flips or fully obscured crest.
Art: crisp high resolution hand-painted 2D game illustration, clear dark edge definition, earthy wood, black iron, teal cloth and white crest; understated warm directional lighting. No glow, blur, drop shadow, ground puddle, backdrop, halo or outside haze. Keep consistent scale, exposure, camera angle and outline weight across every frame.
Transparency: true alpha background, completely clear between sprites and through the tripod gaps. No checkerboard painted into the image, no parchment or colored background, no scenery and absolutely no humans.
This is a brand-new isolated prop asset. The requested six frames must be fully drawn, complete, uncropped and mutually separated.
qa: All six flags have an identical white Mori crest (one bar above three circular discs), complete poles and complete wooden bases; cloth contours are independently redrawn. Raw PNG has actual alpha, no postprocessing or opaque-background removal.
